---
title: "Plant growth"
output: html_document
---

# Setup

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
data(PlantGrowth)
```

# Model

One-way ANOVA of dried weight by treatment.

```{r fit}
fit <- aov(weight ~ group, data = PlantGrowth)
```

```{r, echo=FALSE}
summary(fit)
```

## Group means

```{r means}
means <- tapply(PlantGrowth$weight, PlantGrowth$group, mean)
round(means, 2)
```
